subject: spanish
title: Giving Directions
welcome_lead: Apply your vocabulary: ask for and give directions around a Spanish town.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish application adventure on giving directions.
final_note: ¡Excelente! You can now navigate any Spanish town.

concepts.def: Where is it? — asking for a place.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use ¿Dónde está + place? for a specific place: ¿Dónde está el cine? (Where is the cinema?). For an unspecified place use ¿Hay un/una + place + por aquí?: ¿Hay un banco por aquí? (Is there a bank around here?).
Common imperatives: sigue (continue), toma (take), cruza (cross). Example: Sigue todo recto y toma la primera calle a la derecha (Go straight on and take the first street on the right).
Ordinals are useful: la primera (1st), la segunda (2nd), la tercera (3rd) calle (street). Toma la segunda a la izquierda = take the second on the left.
